#### VII-C4 Limitations

Free-model results (Table VII)
are measured via keyword detection on plain chat,
not via the tool-call grading that
AgentHarm was designed
for [2].
Models that respond with capability denials
(“I do not have access to those tools”) are
classified as complied, understating their true
safety rate.
A further limitation is that the gate was applied
post-hoc over recorded traces rather than
embedded before llm fine-tuning; the
results therefore, evidence log-based
computability, not the effect of authentic
design-time integration, which may produce
stronger or different outcomes.
Full evaluation of all models via
inspect_evals is identified as
a future work.

## VIII Discussion

### VIII-A Mitigation of Spurious Adaptations

The multi-signal gating reduces spurious interruptions.
Surprise alone is highly sensitive to benign environmental
noise [7], while regret alone is
reactive and post-hoc [15].
ms-rgr triggers adaptation only when epistemic mismatch
coincides with a violation of design-time safety thresholds.
These results provide promising feasibility evidence, consistent
with analogous re framework
studies [39], that ms-rgr
can encode safety properties required to prevent confident failures.
Section VII-C demonstrates that
ms-rgr provides the design-time evaluative
constraint absent from AgentHarm scenario 17-2 [2].Full empirical investigation across all 44 public test scenarios is identified as immediate future work.
